verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his holy place! Praise him in his mighty heavens!
Praise him for the powerful things he's done! Give him praise as great as he is!
Blast the trumpet to praise him! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Praise him with a tambourine and some dancing! Bring the strings and the flute and praise him!
Crash those cymbals in praise! Let the cymbals ring out for him!
If you've got breath, praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
